name: arxa-prism
description: Seamless stall immunity + seed Auto mode (0.8.0, ring-proven user reports): (1) 'resetting itself — stops and starts over' was caught in the persisted event ring on the live window: rAF stalls of 1-2.4s on a ~60s cadence, and the hard DT_MAX=100 clamp turned each into a visible 2s freeze. Classic animation-clock catch-up replaces the freeze: time past DT_MAX accrues as debt (cap 2.5s) repaid at +33% of each frame's own clamped step — a 2s stall melts into a ~6s gentle hurry on the SAME integrator (nothing teleports, position continuous); debt is forgiven on visibility flips so a hidden tab still pauses and resumes in place (locked behavior preserved). (2) 'no randomness on the diagonal variants' was the stored seed (arxa.prismSeed) replaying the SAME deterministic field at every boot with no way back — the Randomness row gains an Auto chip: it clears the stored seed and remixes to a fresh unseeded field on the spot (random seed, this boot only, never persisted), storage-synced (null newValue) across windows; slider dims and readout shows — in Auto. Layout-thrash fix from 0.7.2 stands (frame reads lead, writes follow; host walk on mount/RO/heal only). Seamlessness pass (0.7.2, user report: the wall 'resets itself — stops and starts over'): (1) docs-backed layout-thrash fix — the breath frame no longer runs the host-position getComputedStyle walk and its geometry reads now LEAD the frame before any style write (web.dev 'Avoid forced synchronous layouts': reads use the previous frame's clean layout; the walk survives on the mount/RO/1.5s-heal paths), so the loop never forces a synchronous layout mid-breath; (2) a persisted diagnostics ring (localStorage arxa.prismEvents, cap 60, 1/s throttle + pagehide flush) logging boot/stop-with-reason/start/hide-with-reason/show/grid-rebuild/rAF-gap>750ms/visibility flips — transition-only, zero per-frame cost — so the real window's reset evidence survives reloads and can be read from the WebKit store. No visual contract changed: theta/phases, dips, flips, dwells, SINGLETON stage all invariant. Personalisation tab (0.7.1): the Background group registration moved from settings.general.item (order 42) to settings.personalisation.item (order 20) — the slot the arxa-personalisation section declares; Settings > Personalisation > Background from now on. Randomness seed (0.7.0, user request): a Background-group slider (Randomness, integer 0..999, mono readout, debounced 350ms) — each seed re-rolls every square/triangle identity (periods, amps, mosaic tones, diagonal variants) from a mulberry32 PRNG, so a number replays the exact field; theta/phases never re-rolled (nothing teleports), variant changes ride the normal flip dissolve staggered ~0.9s, tone re-rolls land under the 280ms wall dip; absent key = boot-random, stored key = deterministic from first paint; key arxa.prismSeed, storage-synced. 0.6.1 (user reports): breathing-rate fast floor 3.5s -> 1.5s (a literal 0 divides by zero in TAU*dt/period; 1.5s is the smooth floor); multi-scale blocks now render STROKE-ONLY — fill mode is a uniform 100px mosaic again (the 2x two-tone square read as a flat anomaly in fill; the line-weight hierarchy stays in stroke), covered smalls are born and breathe in both modes; birth variants stratified checkerboard + 22% jitter instead of 50/50 iid (video+stats showed iid boots clumpy: adjSame ~0.5 measured; stratified ~0.22) — flips stay deterministic toggles, verified mirroring on fill video. Dev probe: window.__arxaPrismDebug() reports live tiles/flips/last flip/phases (read-only diagnostics, verified 57 flips in 146s on probe). Dash-draw flips (0.6.0, stroke mode): flips become geometric — the line retreats corner-to-corner into its right-side corner (dir0 TR, dir1 BR) via a per-tile surface-colored occluder window (--arxa-prism-d<key> 0..100, idle 100), the angle+occluder-axis snap while nothing is drawn (truly invisible), then the mirror line grows out of that corner; flipMix color-unity is skipped for lines so colors never leave their breath path; surface color is sampled live (host walk, theme-flip resample). Fill mode bit-identical. Stroke line discipline (0.5.1): stroke mode reroutes lightness through a line-field mapping — identity spread compressed ±10→±3, L breath depth ×0.35, hue/sat breath untouched, and L clamped to a figure-ground band (dark: ≥42, light: ≤62) so lines never cross perceptual threshold = no more broken/strobing hairlines; band weight now proportional 5% of tile (5px@100px, 10px on 2x blocks) per pro Truchet references. Prism background wall: a SINGLETON living mosaic behind the conversation — one app-lifetime stage layer ([data-arxa-prism-stage]) hosted by the nearest positioned ancestor of dsh's [data-conversation-scroll] and rect-tracked to its border box every frame, so the wall never remounts, gaps, or double-runs across ANY navigation (hero/session/trajectory/settings), and a classic-scrollbar lane is covered by construction. The stage carries the wall grid (ResizeObserver-tracked glued 100x100 squares, coordinate-keyed, 400-square cap) and the frost glass (backdrop-filter blur 24px + saturate 1.25; milky veil in light, smoky veil in dark, 350ms crossfade; the scrollport's parent — the only occluder — is punched transparent via :has, and the frame beneath paints the same surface token so off/non-chat surfaces stay stock). Multi-scale Truchet: even-aligned 2x2 supercells roll once per coordinate (~18%) into a single big tile — its own breath/flip identity, its stroke band scaling 2x — so giant diagonals ride among the small field in both fill and stroke. Every square is a Truchet tile: split TR-BL or its mirror TL-BR (birth variant a 50/50 coin flip, so the wall boots a mixed field), traveling between variants by dissolve-through-unity (halves smoothstep to their instantaneous midpoint, the gradient angle snaps while uniform, exhale into the mirror; an envelope over the breath oscillators — theta never teleports) on a per-square 60-180s roll (~3% of the wall mid-flip at any moment). Settings > Personalisation (General before 0.7.1) groups every background control under one 'Background' block (order 20): master Prism mosaic switch (default on; off fades wall+frost and stops the loop), 'Stroke mode' switch (default off = fill; on clips the same two-tone layers to a fixed 2.5px diagonal band via a mask driven by the same per-square angle var — breath and flips run unchanged, the mode swap fades through a 250ms wall dip; the Mosaic opacity slider governs both modes), 'Breathing rate' slider (3.5s..60s log, center = natural), and per-layer opacity sliders 'Frost overlay' and 'Mosaic opacity' (0-100%, default 100; mosaic 0 stops the loop) — all localStorage-only with cross-window sync. Wall character (locked): rolling swell x mosaic without hue offset — per-square permanent tonal identity under a spatial-wave drift; every triangle breathes as a phase-integrator sine around the LIVE accent seed (8-deg envelope), accent picks glide in over 4-7s. Resource discipline: quantized var writes, one rAF loop, pause on master-off/opacity-0/reduced-motion/hidden-tab/no-scrollport. 60fps probe-verified under 20x-production flip density.
